profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As a professional my passion for problem-solving led me to computer science and software engineering. I thrive on mastering new technologies and collaborating across teams. Through my university projects and internships, I've built algorithms, data pipelines, interpreters, and more from the ground up. While programming excites me, I'm most fulfilled by creating products that positively impact people's lives. I can't wait to continuously grow and apply my skills to meaningful work.

In my free time, you can find me in the gym, volunteering at an animal shelter, or building something new. I've always loved tinkering and bringing ideas to life. My thirst for knowledge drew me to Stoic philosophy thinkers like Seneca who inspire me to continually improve. I balance my analytical mind with creativity and adventure.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
▪ Provide clients with phone and in person classroom support to ensure operational optimization. 
▪ Used tools like ServiceNow to document and fix operational incidents.
▪ Trained newly hired IT specialists on full workflow including troubleshooting, documentation, and end user support.
▪ Assisted IT director by streamlining the documentation process.
▪ Was chosen to be part of a new team that translates technical issues/knowledge to clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Merrimack County, New Hampshire, United States
positions.description:
▪ Designed and implemented an innovative time management software using Angular, providing visual task 
representation, employee access control, and compliance tracking.
▪ Enhanced internal websites with TypeScript, jQuery, Angular, prioritizing user-centric UI/UX design.
▪ Skilled in Angular, encompassing directives, modules, components, dependency injection, pipes, and templates.
▪ Contributed to Agile project by providing deliverables to product owner ahead of schedule.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Git · Big Data Analytics

positions.title: IT Internal Audit/JavaScript Intern
positions.description:
▪ Enhanced software performance and security through JavaScript code optimization and debugging.
▪ Conducted software audits, ensuring compliance and testing adherence, utilizing JavaScript skills.
▪ Used ServiceNow and Jira to streamline data synthesis for reporting to senior management.
▪ Streamlined audit documentation, reducing manual effort, and enhancing efficiency with JavaScript expertise.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
▪ Transformed FBI data into Tableau dashboards, enhancing reporting, visualization, and data insights.
▪ Proficiently cleaned, analyzed large datasets using Python, Pandas, SQL for informed decision-making. 
▪ Bridged data science and software engineering, working with cross-functional teams on solutions.
▪ Excelled in Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Tableau, Jupyter Notebook, MongoDB for versatile data management.

positions.title: Account Executive Sales & Business Development Intern
positions.description:
▪ Contact current customers to up-sell new categories on the platform.
▪ Build relationships with clients to understand the needs of each client.
▪ Generate and describe creative, results-focused marketing concepts to a diverse client base.
▪ Perform cold calling to get the attention of possible new clients and make sale presentations.

volunteerExperiences.description:
▪ Developed proficiency in HTML, React, CSS, and JavaScript to program website applications.
▪ Gained competence to optimize data structures to efficiently store and search for data in databases.
▪ Developed proficiency in HTML, React, CSS, and JavaScript to program website applications in React.
▪ Architected RESTful APIs with Django Framework, enabling data exchange between front-end and back-end

▪ Provided important services by manufacturing copies of student’s documents for my administrator.
▪ Mailed vital appointment letters to parents.
▪ Made phone calls to remind clients of appointments.
▪ Help overseer important documents by making file folders.
